_comment: URLs that other people have published pointing at this site, and the ones we
have reason to believe they published in the past. `npm run check:links`
This is NOT a backlink index — it cannot be. Backlinks live on other people's
servers and the only complete lists are Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster
Tools and the commercial crawlers. See docs/INBOUND-LINKS.md for how to get
them. This file is the subset we know about, kept so that a URL somebody else
already published can never silently break again.
Add to it whenever a referral shows up in Analytics, whenever Search Console
reports a 404 with a referring page, and whenever a URL shape is retired.

links.note: French travel guide to Zakynthos. This is the referral that exposed the whole problem; the /en redirect exists because of it.
What /en/ normalises to. Checked separately because the trailing-slash 308 runs independently of the redirect.
The www host. Redirected to the apex in next.config; asserted here so that rule cannot be dropped unnoticed.
